verdict.rationale: Docusign publishes an official GitHub repo (docusign/OpenAPI-Specifications) of OpenAPI/Swagger files. It says they are used to generate its client SDKs via swagger-codegen and are meant to let both humans and computers discover the service's capabilities. The probe's 404s at guessed developer-portal paths don't contradict this, since the spec is hosted on GitHub instead. Missing for 10: a discoverable spec URL on the developer portal (the standard /openapi.json paths 404), detail on which APIs the specs cover and their versions, and independent hands-on corroboration of downloading and using the spec.
